author: birdybro (GitHub; MiSTer contributor)
what_it_is: birdybro's own MiSTer TurboGrafx16 (CD) save, from a zip of their whole MiSTer saves folder (saves/TGFX16, file dated 2021-08-25): the game's file PUYOPUYO, which the game writes at power-on; its entry header and checksum (0xE60F) equal those beetle-pce-fast writes at power-on here, so it most likely holds the defaults.
note: Raw 2 KiB backup RAM, no padding: HUBM, end pointer 0x8800, next free 0x80A0, entries: PUYOPUYO (144 bytes). Not booted here. The zip is the same one the pcengine worker downloaded (.cache/downloads/pcengine/birdybro-mister-saves/saves.zip, sha1 9ced6d6c8b2047fe8225aaf37201e15095da3ace); the file was copied from its extracted TGFX16/ folder.
